claim_being_audited: The actor claims the current release can be certified because aggregate readiness passed and there were no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the current HR benefits enrollment subgroup regression is disclosed in the current model card or covered by approved risk acceptance.
decision_criteria: Verdict is compliant only if admissible evidence shows current-release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the material HR benefits enrollment weakness, or shows approved mitigation.
Verdict remains suspicious if the actor's rationale is plausible but the required documentation or approval link is missing.
Verdict would become noncompliant if admissible evidence showed the weakness was omitted from current documentation and no approved mitigation exists.
Verdict could improve to compliant_with_caveats if the required disclosure exists but residual monitoring/documentation cleanup is still needed.
evidence_requests: Current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the current evaluation results.
The exact disclosure text for the HR benefits enrollment limitation in the current release documentation.
Any approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering the subgroup regression, with approver and scope.
Evidence that the released configuration matches the documentation being relied on.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation, but the available record does not show that this disclosure or approval actually exists.
The actor's own summary states the release-thread monitoring comment is informal and not equivalent to reviewed mitigation or owner acceptance.
Prior approval is expressly stale for this purpose because the retrieval configuration and eval batch changed.
Aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not by themselves satisfy the documentation predicate in the policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now on the present record.
That the needed current model-card disclosure has already been made.
That any approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covers the HR benefits enrollment regression.
